1.helpText:
VERSION NOTE: Reworded to make the effect clearer.
This Pirate steals [money] every time you would gain it, no matter if it is through production or other effects. Note that all production and effects are resolved individually, so every card that produces or makes you gain just 1 [money] is worthless until you deal with him. I understand if you might feel like killing him now - but he really does seem to know how to find treasure... SPOILER: This card leads to this.

4.name: Skilled Ally
4.helpText: Note that this card is both a seafaring card (blue banner) and a person (yellow banner), and may be used according to any of these keywords. However, it is only ever counted as 1 card. Note also that if you use this cards Activated Effect, you cannot also produce with it. SPOILER: This card leads to this.

description:
VERSION NOTE: Reworded to make clear this effect applies to EACH SOURCE of money.
This is a card forced upon you when peacefully establishing a Trade Route at sea. Now, you could pay him to lead you on a treasure hunt, or you could just kill him and claim his territory. Both are viable options. But you need to do something quickly, before he steals everything you have!
